history.summary: An anonymously-listed 969 sqft 3BR in D12 (Boon Keng) at $2.35M / $2,425 PSF, with no project name, no confirmed tenure, and no built year. Right next to Boon Keng MRT (40m) but a very high PSF on a small unit with zero verifiable project data.
history.rating_rationale: $2,425 PSF for a 969 sqft 3BR in D12 Boon Keng is aggressive — above most resale norms for the area and a $2.35M quantum that thins the buyer pool. The listing hides the project name, leaves tenure blank, and has no built year or URA data, so neither appreciation nor liquidity can be assessed. A 40m MRT walk is the only clear positive; not enough to justify a full-price, data-blind buy.
